site.title: {project} - Okuyovola Olombongo Ka Vakavi
site.description: {project] osi software ya peer-to-peer yokuyovola olombongo, yatungiwa pa otekinolojia yokwenjuhuka yokuhayambela.
site.ogDescription: Okuyovola olombongo kuna peer-to-peer ku otekinolojia yokwenjuhuka. Ka kuli olosaliva vyokuyambela. Ka kuli ocina cimosi cokuvota.

hero.subtitle: Okuyovola olombongo ka peer-to-peer kepola lyokwenda
hero.description: Pa otekinolojia yokwenjuhuka yokuhayambela. Ka kuli olosaliva vyokuyambela. Ka kuli ocina cimosi cokuvota.

about.title: Pa
about.intro: {project} oyo plataforma yepola lyokwenda yokuyovola olombongo ka peer-to-peer yatungiwa pa otekinolojia yokwenjuhuka yokuhayambela. Yi kuongela interface yapelela yomulingisi vamwe lokwenjuhuka kuosi, yi eca okuyovola olombongo kuanyala kwenda kuayalelisa kuli oyenjikilo yikuavo yokuyambela. Oprojeti yi osi open source, yi yovoliwa kepwakelo lya {license}.

decentralized.title: Onetewoki yokwenjuhuka kuosi
decentralized.description: Ka kuli olosaliva vyokuyambela, ka kuli ocina cimosi cokuvota. Olombongi olo vasanga lokuyovola olombongo pakati kavo, kuyalelisa kuli indexer, tracker yenda database yokuyambela ya yiyukile.

accessControl.title: Olondunge vyokupita ka cimosi
accessControl.description: Omunu wosi olo wokupanga onetewoki yaye yikola onayepa kuli ovihandeleko vyaye. Ko netewoki yiyukile, kapula olondunge violombongi: cuma, admin, ovesi okusangelela, moderator lokutambula. Yala ka cimosi nye omunu olo wapanga, modera lokutambula olombongo.

ui.title: Interface yomulingisi yikuanetela
ui.description: Interface yo media center yapelela yokupelela yatungiwa pa desktop, TV lo platafoma vyo simu. Okwenda kupelela kuli keyboard, mouse, gamepad yenda kontrolu yokule. Olombongi vakuli olondunge vapondola okukungulula osoftware ndo ofile server yokuhamisi pa command-line interface.

dataFormat.title: Olonjila vya data omanu vapondola okuvitanga
dataFormat.description: Olonjila vya data ya LISH yatungiwa pa JSON, yi pelela okupanga, okutanga lokuvelela. Yovola olombongo vyove lo metadata yacalata yi monekele, omunu wosi vapondola okuvelela ka cimosi.

security.title: Okuholama lokuyukila
security.description: Olonjila viosi vyo peer-to-peer vi kuendisivila lo encryption, okuyalelisa data yove yi sale yokuholama yokwenda. Olombongi vapondola okuyikilila kuli kunyima yo VPN, okwendisila kuli oholo yokuhayikiwa. {project} yi sumbila okuholama kwove pa otungo lyaye.

crossPlatform.title: Cross-platform
crossPlatform.description: Software yi sangiwa ko Windows, Linux lo macOS. Yi yendisile ko cina cina cosi co kanyini.

download.title: Tambula
download.description: Tambula {project} yo plataforma yove. Olovotelo viosi vi osi vyokwenjuhuka lo open source.

macos.title: Esapulo lyimwe lyikuanetela koviumbi vyo macOS:
macos.intro: macOS Gatekeeper yi tepa ovi-app vyokuhasoneka/notarized vyatambuliwa ko internet, lo nepoluelo lyo {error}.
